title: The Crystal Cave Adventure
moral: Courage and teamwork help overcome fears.

scenes.summary: Lily and friends begin a journey to find a magical crystal.
scenes.text: Lily and her friends went to a snowy mountain to find a magical crystal.
scenes.image_prompt: kids climbing snowy mountain with backpacks, bright cartoon

scenes.text: They had to cross a frozen river carefully to continue their journey.
scenes.image_prompt: kids crossing frozen river on branches, winter cartoon

scenes.summary: They enter a cave and face a blocked path.
scenes.text: Inside the cave, a big rock blocked their way to the crystal.
scenes.image_prompt: kids inside cave with giant rock obstacle, fantasy cartoon

scenes.summary: They move the rock and find the crystal.
scenes.text: They used a lever to move the rock and found the glowing crystal.
scenes.image_prompt: kids pulling lever and discovering crystal, magical cartoon

scenes.summary: Lily makes a wish and they return home.
scenes.text: Lily wished for courage and returned home happily with her friends.
scenes.image_prompt: kids smiling after adventure in snowy village, warm cartoon

story: Lily and her friends went to a snowy mountain to find a magical crystal. They crossed a frozen river and entered a cave where a big rock blocked their way. Using teamwork, they moved the rock and found the crystal. Lily wished for courage, and they returned home happy and proud.
